text.aria-label: Title text 'The effects filter does not beat GAM-K, and holding the level on holidays hurts'

g.text: The effects filter does not beat GAM-K, and holding the level on holidays hurts

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: difference in mean quantile score at day D+1 (leads 15 to 39 hours) over the five decision substations, rows outside the switching events. Line: interval from resampling whole calendar months (C1 to C5, 99%) or whole days (holiday days, 95%), paired across arms. Dashed line: no difference.'
